timeline.title: Our
timeline.sub: Five milestones that tell forty-three years in spare parts.

milestones.label: Founded
milestones.title: Nicola Fiordaliso opens Abelec
milestones.desc: Small spare parts workshop in Binche, Hainaut.
milestones.line1: In 1983, Nicola Fiordaliso founded Abelec in a small workshop in Hainaut with a simple conviction: to offer Belgian repairers the parts unavailable elsewhere.
milestones.line2: The business started with about a hundred references for washing machines and refrigerators, sold to local technicians and households in the Charleroi basin.

milestones.label: Catalogue
milestones.title: First printed parts catalogue
milestones.line1: After fourteen years of organic growth, Abelec published its first printed catalogue: 5,000 references classified by brand and appliance type.
milestones.line2: Distributed to hundreds of repairers, it became the independent technician’s bible in the region. Orders arrived by fax and phone.

milestones.label: E-commerce
milestones.title: Launch of Abelec.be
milestones.desc: The business goes online — 25 years after its founding.
milestones.line1: In 2008, Abelec took the digital leap. Private customers could now order directly, without going through an approved technician.
milestones.line2: Detailed technical sheets, installation guides, model compatibility. Turnover doubled in three years thanks to the national reach of the web.

milestones.label: Europe
milestones.title: Expansion to 6 European countries
milestones.desc: FR, NL, DE, IT, LU join Belgium.
milestones.line1: With a catalogue expanded to 60,000 references, Abelec opened its borders to five new markets. Translated interfaces, local carriers, adapted lead times.
milestones.line2: A centralised stock in Belgium guarantees dispatch within 48h across Western Europe. The family business became a continental reference.

milestones.label: V2
milestones.title: 3D identification · 100,000 refs.
milestones.desc: New platform, real-time helpdesk, interactive 3D view.
milestones.line1: Abelec launches its second-generation platform: 3D interactive part identification, real-time human helpdesk, catalogue of 100,000 references.
milestones.line2: Artificial intelligence helps private customers identify the fault — without knowing the exact model number.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Abelec collects, uses and protects your personal data, in accordance with GDPR.
privacy.gdprDisclaimer: Abelec is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR – EU Regulation 2016/679) and applicable Belgian law.
privacy.s1Intro: In connection with your use of the site and your purchases, Abelec collects the following categories of data:
privacy.s1Closing: Abelec does not collect sensitive data within the meaning of Article 9 of the GDPR (health data, political opinion, religion, etc.). Payment data is managed exclusively by our PCI-DSS certified payment providers and does not transit our servers.
privacy.s2Intro: The data collected is used for the following purposes, on the basis of the corresponding legal grounds:
privacy.s2Closing: Abelec does not sell or share your personal data to third parties for commercial purposes. Your data may be shared with subcontractors strictly necessary for the performance of our services (carriers, payment providers, hosting), bound by GDPR-compliant confidentiality agreements.
privacy.s3Intro: Your data is retained for specific periods depending on its nature:
privacy.s3Dur1: 3 years after the last order or login
privacy.s3Detail2: In accordance with Belgian accounting obligations (art. III.86 CDE)
privacy.s3Detail5: Or until the exercise of the right to erasure
privacy.s3Detail6: Proof of consent retained for 5 years
privacy.s3Closing: Upon expiry of the retention periods, data is securely deleted or irreversibly anonymised. No data is retained beyond these periods without a legal basis.
privacy.s4Intro: In accordance with the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data. Each request will be processed within a maximum of one month.
privacy.s4Right1Desc: You may obtain a copy of all personal data we hold about you.
privacy.s4Right2Desc: You may request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
privacy.s4Right3Desc: You may request deletion of your data under certain conditions ('right to be forgotten').
privacy.s4Right4Desc: You may receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format for transfer to another controller.
privacy.s4Right5Desc: You may object to certain processing, in particular for direct marketing purposes.
privacy.s4Right6Desc: You may request restriction of processing of your data in specific cases provided for by the GDPR.
privacy.s4Closing: To exercise any of these rights, contact our DPO at
privacy.s4ClosingMid: attaching a copy of your identity document. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority:
privacy.s5Intro: The abelec.be website uses cookies and similar technologies. A cookie is a small text file placed on your device during your visit. You can configure your browser to refuse cookies, but some site features may no longer be available.
privacy.s5Cookie1Purpose: Shopping cart and user session management
privacy.s5Closing: You can change your cookie preferences at any time via our cookie management banner at the bottom of the page, or via your browser settings.
privacy.s6Intro: Abelec has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) responsible for ensuring GDPR compliance and answering your questions about data protection.

aPropos.heroSub: A Belgian family business, a passion for repair
aPropos.s1Title: Since 1983, we help Belgians repair their household appliances
aPropos.s1p1: Abelec was born from a simple belief: a broken appliance deserves a second chance. Founded in 1983 in Péronnes-lez-Binche by Robert Delcourt, our family business has built over the decades one of the most comprehensive spare parts stocks in Belgium — more than 100,000 references available for all major household appliances.
aPropos.s1p2: Where others offer immediate replacement, we choose repair. This philosophy guides every one of our decisions, from supplier selection to technician training. Our customers have trusted us for forty years because they know they will find the right part, at the right price, delivered quickly.
aPropos.s1p3: Today, Abelec ships to six European countries and continues to grow — without ever losing the family and craft DNA that has been our strength since day one.
aPropos.val1Desc: Every request is handled by a trained technician. Our teams know the parts and the machines they service.
aPropos.val2Desc: All our parts are inspected before shipping. We only offer original references or equivalent quality.
aPropos.val3Desc: Repair rather than replace — our conviction since 1983. Every part sold prevents one more appliance from ending up in landfill.
aPropos.team1Bio: Founded Abelec in 1983 with the conviction that repairing is always better than discarding.
aPropos.team2Bio: 40 years of experience in diagnosing and repairing household appliances of all brands.
aPropos.team3Bio: First point of contact, she accompanies each customer from part search to delivery.
aPropos.team4Bio: Ensures every order leaves the warehouse correctly packed and on time.

chatbot.title: Abelec Assistant
chatbot.greeting: Hello! I'm the Abelec assistant. Choose a question below or contact us directly.
chatbot.a1: We deliver in 3 to 5 business days in Belgium. Express 24h delivery is also available at checkout.
chatbot.q2: How do I find my part?
chatbot.a2: Enter your appliance reference or part number in our search bar. Our catalogue covers more than 200 brands.
chatbot.q3: How do I make a return?
chatbot.a3: You have 14 days after receipt to return an unmounted part. Contact us by email to receive a free return label.
chatbot.q4: How do I track my order?
chatbot.a4: Once shipped, you receive an email with a tracking link. You can also check the history in your customer account.
chatbot.a5: We offer parts for more than 200 brands: Bosch, Siemens, Miele, Whirlpool, Samsung, LG, Electrolux, AEG and many more.
chatbot.a6: Enter the full reference of your appliance (model + serial number) in the search. If in doubt, our team checks compatibility for free.
